privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.collectContent: To provide platform services, we only collect information necessary for the features: account details (username, nickname, phone number, email), login logs (login time, IP address, device and browser information), and the business data you actively enter while using the various functional modules.
privacyPolicy.useContent: The information collected is used only for: identity verification and account security, access control, operation auditing, and the proper functioning of product features. We will not use your information for any purpose beyond those listed above.
privacyPolicy.storageContent: Passwords are stored with irreversible BCrypt encryption. Sensitive fields (phone numbers, ID numbers, etc.) support encryption with Chinese national cryptographic algorithms and permission-based masked display. Transmission supports SM2/SM4 encryption. The platform has built-in access control, data permissions, and tenant isolation to prevent unauthorized access.
privacyPolicy.shareContent: Unless we obtain your explicit authorization or applicable laws and regulations require otherwise, we will not share or sell your personal information to any third party.
privacyPolicy.rightsContent: You can view and correct your account information and change your password in the User Center. If you need to delete your account or erase your data, please contact the system administrator.
privacyPolicy.changeContent: If this policy is updated, we will notify you via platform announcements. Continuing to use the platform after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.

gis.emptyDesc: GIS is on by default. Add at least one provider key under Basemap, then the map will load. Set gis.module.enabled to false to hide this module.
gis.mapHint: Tiles are proxied by the server so keys never reach the browser.
gis.helpTianditu: Tianditu: request a tk from the national geospatial platform console.
gis.helpAmap: Amap: request a Web Service key (geocode/search). Tiles are server-proxied; JS security code is not required.
gis.helpBaidu: Baidu: request an ak from the maps open platform.
gis.helpGoogle: Google: a Map Tiles API key (official tile.googleapis.com only).
gis.keyKeepHint: A key is already stored. Leave blank to keep it (encrypted, never shown).
gis.removeConfirm: Clear the key for "{name}"? The map will switch to another configured basemap
gis.secretHint: Keys stay on the server. Map tiles are fetched through authenticated same-origin URLs.
gis.hintPan: Drag to pan, scroll to zoom. Click empty map to reverse-geocode; click a shape to select it. Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Y undo and redo.
gis.hintSelect: Click a shape to edit vertices. Delete removes the selection.
gis.hintPoint: Click the map to drop a point.
gis.hintLine: Click to add vertices, double-click to finish. Length is shown while drawing.
gis.hintPolygon: Click to add vertices, double-click to close. Area is shown while drawing.
gis.hintCircle: Click the center, then click again for the radius.
gis.hintRect: Click and drag a rectangle, release to finish.
gis.hintText: Click to drop a label. Edit the name in the inspector to change the text.
gis.hintMeasureLength: Click distance vertices, double-click to finish. The result is stored as a layer.
gis.hintMeasureArea: Click area vertices, double-click to close. The result is stored as a layer.
gis.drawNeed2d: Drawing and measuring happen in 2D. Switched back. 3D only shows saved shapes.
gis.featEmpty: Nothing drawn yet. Sketch, measure, or search a place to drop a point. Saving the scene writes them into layers.
gis.featClearConfirm: Clear every sketch and measurement on this scene? Unsaved edits will be lost.
gis.locateDenied: Location is unavailable. Allow browser geolocation and retry.
gis.emptySceneList: No scenes yet. Create one, draw on the map, then save
gis.emptySceneSearch: No scenes match. Try another name
gis.deleteSceneConfirm: Delete "{name}"? Drawings go with it and it leaves the list
gis.located: Flown and dropped on the layer
gis.importEmpty: No drawable features in this file
gis.importReplaceConfirm: Import replaces the current sketch (save the scene first). Continue?
gis.trackHeatEmpty: No geotagged events, or missing analytics permission
gis.pickEmpty: Click the map to pick a location
gis.inspectEmpty: Select a feature to edit name, color, and notes.
gis.layerNameRequired: Enter a layer name so you can tell it apart on the list and the map
gis.emptyLayerList: No layers yet. Add one and paste data to preview it on the map
gis.emptyLayerSearch: No layers match. Try another name
gis.layerRemoveConfirm: Delete "{name}"? It leaves the list and the map
gis.layerHint: Paste GeoJSON, lon/lat records, or WKT / CSV / KML / GPX. Stored as WGS84; extra properties are kept. XYZ/WMS needs a service URL.
gis.wsCoach: Pick a tool on the left, draw, then save. Heatmaps and tracks live in Examples.
gis.overlayDemoHint: No sketches yet. Pick Point / Line / Polygon on the toolbar and draw on the map.
gis.labIntro: Pick an example on the left. The map fills the page; open Source when you need the API.
gis.labDataEmpty: Results appear here after you interact with the map
gis.labHintRadius: Click to move the 800 m search circle
gis.labHintMeasure: Click to draw a line or polygon
gis.labHintPlayback: Patrol vehicle along Chang'an Ave. Drag the slider or change speed.
gis.labHintRaster: A label layer overlaid as XYZ raster on the imagery basemap; toggle and fade it below
gis.labHintIngest: Switch format to load a sample, then parse it through /layer/ingest
gis.labOpsNoMetrics: Done — see metrics in the code panel
gis.labRasterBad: Invalid raster spec: XYZ needs tile placeholders, WMS needs layers
gis.labIngestPlaceholder: Paste WKT / CSV / KML / GPX, or GeoJSON
gis.labIngestFailed: Parse failed — check the format and coordinate order (lon before lat)
gis.analyzeHint: Analysis runs JTS server-side: normalize to WGS84 GeoJSON, compute in Web Mercator metres. Save results to the layer catalog and overlay by layerId.
gis.analyzeEmpty: Pick a source layer or paste coordinates first
gis.layerBadPayload: No geographic features recognized. Check that the text is complete
gis.overlayEmpty: No overlays yet. Click a catalog layer below to add it.
gis.layerCoach: Click a layer to preview. Overlay it on the map to adjust opacity and save into a scene.
gis.providerCoach: Click a provider to preview the basemap. Keys stay on the server and are not shown here.
gis.sceneCoach: Click a scene to preview, then open it in the map to keep drawing.
gis.analyzeCoach: Pick a layer or paste coordinates. Results draw on the map and can be saved to the catalog.
gis.terrainUnsetTip: Set gis.terrain.url (a quantized-mesh terrain service) in parameter management first.
gis.terrainFailed: Terrain service unreachable, fell back to a flat globe.
gis.extrudeEmpty: No polygon to extrude. Draw one or add a polygon layer first.
gis.tilesetEmpty: No 3D tileset yet. Pick a 3D Tiles layer from the catalog.
gis.tilesetNeed3d: 3D tilesets render in the 3D view only.
gis.tilesetFailed: Failed to load tileset "{name}". Check whether the tileset URL is reachable.
gis.labTilesetHint: The sample tileset ships with the app: 16 buildings across 4 tiles; click one to see its name, floors, usage and year built.
gis.labTilesetPickHint: Click a model to inspect its properties.
gis.tilesetUrlHint: Use hosted:demo-city for the bundled sample, or https://.../tileset.json for your own data
gis.wsTiledHint: Large layer rendered as vector tiles: only the current viewport is fetched; export and whole-layer stats are unavailable
gis.wsQueryPickCenter: Click the map to set the center
gis.enginePostgisTip: Spatial queries and vector tiles run in the database
gis.engineJavaTip: PostGIS is missing: spatial queries run in memory and vector tiles are unavailable. Rebuild the database with the repo docker-compose (postgis/postgis image)
